title: Who holds U.S. debt? Top 10 foreign holders
units: billions of U.S. dollars, holdings at end of month

total_foreign.units: billions of dollars, quarterly, end of period

notes: Country-level data begins 2000; earlier years show total foreign holdings only.
TIC country series begins 2000-03 (mfhhis01.txt). Where TIC re-based the series (series breaks), the newer series value is used.
Regional aggregates reported by TIC in early years (Oil Exporters, Caribbean Banking Centers) are excluded from the country ranking; 'Belgium-Luxembourg' is shown as reported.
FRED FDHBFIN begins 1970-01 (quarterly); chart starts 1971 (Nixon closes the gold window, Aug 15 1971).
